desc:
The Otter Creek Labs Infinity 556K takes the proven DNA of the full-size Infinity 762 and packs it into a shorter, lighter 5.56 can built for hard-use rifles. It runs across AR-15s, AK hosts, bolt guns, and SBRs without turning your rifle into a brick or causing reliability issues, and the swappable end cap system means you can tune the backpressure instead of living with the factory default.

Features & Benefits

Additively manufactured Haynes 282 superalloy body built for punishing firing schedules

Compact 5.5 inch, 14.5 oz footprint that keeps short builds handy

Rated for 5.56 NATO and 6mm hosts

Interchangeable back pressure end caps: medium installed, low and high available separately

HUB 1.375x24 rear thread pattern works with Bravo and most QD mounts on the market

Lifetime warranty, with an Elite Package that adds all three end caps, a Rearden Atlas mount, and a Rearden SPB brake

Base Package Includes:

Infinity 556K Suppressor

One End Cap (Medium, installed)

Tube Clamp

Stickers

Infinity 556K Mount Compatibility (HUB / Bravo / 1.375x24)

Rearden Atlas Moun bundled directly by OCL in the Elite Package alongside the Rearden SPB muzzle brake; the most directly OCL-confirmed pairing available.

Dead Air Key-Mo and Dead Air Xeno

SilencerCo Bravo ASR

Q Plan-B (HUB)

Griffin Armament A2 Adapter, Plan A, and Dual-Lok

YHM Kurz QD Adapter and YHM Phantom QD Adapter

Energetic Armament Vox direct thread mount
